What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Our warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal household use. The coverage period depends on the item:
Warmers bought before March 20, 2026: 1 year from purchase.
Warmers bought on or after March 20, 2026: 6 months from purchase. Registering the warmer within 60 days of purchase makes it eligible for a free 2-year limited warranty.
Warmer lightbulbs: 90 days from purchase.
Silicone dishes: 6 months from purchase.
During the initial warranty period, the manufacturer replaces parts or products affected by manufacturer defects at no charge. During the extended limited warranty period, those replacements are offered at a 50% discount.
The warranty doesn’t cover accidental damage, abuse, neglect, use with an incorrect power supply, attempted repairs, loss, or theft. You can find the policy on our Shipping, Warranty, & Returns page.
